title: Branch from develop and PR into develop; only develop enters staging and only staging enters main
body: Flow: feature/* -> develop (integration, no deploy, version bump here) -> staging (Pages preview with the Function running, smoke) -> main (production, cribbnicolas.pages.dev). `develop` exists to batch: without it every small PR fires a preview deploy (a Cloudflare build and, once someone opens /cv.pdf, a Browser Rendering render). The budget copes; the point is noise — twenty deploys a week make the deploy history meaningless. Open develop->staging only when what accumulated is worth publishing; watch smoke-deploy.yml pass on staging, then staging->main. Promotion PRs do not touch the version. There is no hotfix path straight to main on purpose (flujo-de-ramas.yml); if ever needed, disable the check in the ruleset and re-enable it.
not_derivable: Why develop exists (deploy noise, not budget) and the publish cadence are not in code.

evidence.summary: Rejects PRs into staging/main from the wrong source branch or a fork.
